title: The Hacktivist Heist
story:
In a sleek tech startup in the heart of Silicon Valley, an audacious theft occurred. The CTO, a renowned inventor known as Dr. Ignacio Alvarez, discovered a significant drop in stock data. Rumors claim his groundbreaking AI assistant prototype had been snatched from the secure tech lab.

Crime Scene: Secure Tech Lab
Victim: Dr. Ignacio Alvarez (AI assistant prototype)
Forensic Clue: An encrypted message from the hacker, 'Unlock the Truth'

Witnesses:
1. Maria Ramirez: 'I logged off at 10 AM but noticed the breach at 10:05 AM.'
2. Sarah Thompson: 'The meeting started at 10 AM, and I was focused on the investors, not the lab.'
3. Lab tech, Mark Johnson: 'I received the security alert at 10:05 AM but was called to fix a faulty ventilation system.'
4. Hacker, Peter Kim: 'The message arrived at 10:10 AM after the crime.'
